thread:
maya: Quick note we saw a cluster of schema rejects on payments.process after the strict flip in a small EU canary. Ops only caught it via a customer ticket.
owen: Any sample payloads?
maya: Logs show things like: ```json
{"tx_id":"a1","amount_cents":"1500","card":{"last4": 4321}}
``` validator expects ints for amount_cents and strings for last4.
li: Classic adapter mismatch (numbers vs strings). Also some adapters add extra metadata fields under card.meta which strict validation rejects.
owen: Short fixes: 1) adapters hotfix to stringify last4 & coerce amounts; 2) make canary non-billable for validation.rejected; 3) enable permissive/coerce mode during canary and log diffs.
maya: +1. Console gap: dashboard sampling was too low. We need adaptive sampling that increases when reject_rate spikes and a payload-diff view in route details.
li: Proposed adaptive sampler: base 0.5%, spike 40% when rejects/min > 8, backoff 60m. Also emit validator.outcome=(ok|coerced|rejected) and coercion_summary in traces.
ops-bot: Filed alert rule request to increase sampling on spike.
billing-bot: Billing ticket created to exempt canary validation rejects from charges (tagged finance).
owen: Action items: li -> PR for decision matrix (coerce rules + per-route strict_level), maya -> console ticket for payload-diff + replay-with-consent, ops-bot -> sampling alert, billing-bot -> billing exclusion.
li: I'll include tests for amount float->int coercion (lossless) and last4 stringify.
maya: Thanks. If you see more rejects paste sample ids here so I can pull full logs. :thumbsup:
